rationale: Identity was properly verified via email, the agent accessed the correct user and orders, and the returns were requested on delivered orders with correct item IDs. However, the agent submitted return requests immediately after the user said they wanted to return all items, without first restating the exact changes (orders, items, and refund destinations) and obtaining explicit confirmation before performing the write, which the policy requires. When the user later asked to refund to the opposite payment methods, the agent declined based on a stated restriction that isn’t explicitly supported by the provided policy/tools, though there was no available tool to modify the refund method after submission. Final information about refunds going to original payment methods aligns with the tool state. Overall, the missing explicit pre-write confirmation of the exact changes leads to a fail under the stated pass bar.
